request: make the header/footer look like this template — the batch mixes clean specs with messy ones
summary: Give every section the template's headers and footers (cover section ← template cover, body sections ← template body). The section number comes from each spec's current footer. The section title is extracted by a fallback chain so one spec serves the whole batch: first the paragraph after a standalone 'SECTION nn nn nn' line (clean specs), else the text after the dash on an inline 'SECTION nn nn nn – TITLE' line (messy specs, including ones with non-breaking spaces). The issue stamp is the approved wording. Files that match neither layout are set aside for the next pass, never edited.
assumptions: template slots are the yellow-highlighted placeholders and the {{NAME}} placeholders (decision §14.2)
the section number is the 'nn nn nn' at the start of the document's current footer
the section title is the first non-empty paragraph after a standalone 'SECTION nn nn nn' paragraph, or — when there is none — the text after the dash of an inline 'SECTION nn nn nn – TITLE' paragraph
runs of spaces, tabs and non-breaking spaces in the section line are matched as one space; the extracted title keeps the document's own characters
header/footer distances and titlePg follow the template; page margins stay as they are
pending tracked changes inside the old headers/footers are discarded with them and flagged by name

expect.members_removed: the old header/footer parts the template replaces (count differs per file)
